duration.text: The Investment at Southwestern University of Finance and Economics is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2305 USD/per year ￥ 16600 CNY/per year

materials.text: Certificate of HSK (for Chinese medium programs) HSK Level 6 or higher. High school academic transcript High school graduate certificate This MUST be notarized by Chinese Embassy/Consulate General in your home country. Study plan Including study purpose, research interest and research plan in brief. Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant English proficiency test certificate (Only for English medium programs) For example, IELTS or TOEFL, only for applicant whose native language is not English.

requirements.text: Have graduated from a senior middle school or quivalent, HSK 6 or above, obey Chinese laws, and without fatal health problems.
